name: ReturnsUp Connector for WooCommerce
author: ReturnsUp

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce returns and exchanges into a seamless, automated experience.
ReturnsUp Connector integrates your store with the ReturnsUp platform, allowing customers to manage returns and exchanges through a self-service portal while keeping your store fully synchronized.

Customers can choose the option that best fits their needs:

  • Size exchanges – Customers can change to a different size of the same product. ReturnsUp connects to your store and checks real-time inventory availability before allowing the exchange.
  • Product exchanges – Customers can return one product and exchange it for another, with automated cart handling and checkout flow.
  • Store credit refunds – Customers can choose a refund in the form of a discount coupon, with the option to include an extra bonus to encourage future purchases.
  • Original payment method refunds – Customers can request a refund to the original payment method used for the purchase, according to your store’s return rules.

WooCommerce® is a trademark of Automattic Inc. ReturnsUp is not affiliated with or endorsed by Automattic Inc.

This plugin ensures your store data remains synchronized with the ReturnsUp platform, improving the customer experience throughout the entire return and exchange process.

Why ReturnsUp?

  • ⏱️ Save Time – Automate returns and exchanges management and reduce manual work.
  • 😊 Better Customer Experience – Offer a professional self-service return portal.
  • 📊 Actionable Insights – Analyze return reasons to improve products and reduce future returns.
  • 🔄 Flexible Return Options – Size exchanges, product exchanges, store credit, or refunds to the original payment method.

Key Features

  • Secure Connection – Connects your store to the ReturnsUp platform via secure API authentication.
  • Real-time Inventory Checks – Validates stock availability in real time for size and product exchanges.
  • Automated Returns & Exchanges – Supports multiple return scenarios:
    • Size exchanges based on real-time inventory.
    • Product-for-product exchanges.
    • Store credit refunds with optional bonus incentives.
    • Refunds to the original payment method.
  • Automated Cart & Checkout Flow –
    • Automatically adds exchange products to the cart.
    • Applies exchange or store credit coupons without manual intervention.
    • Redirects customers to checkout to finalize the process.
  • Smart Checkout – Pre-fills checkout fields for a faster and smoother experience.
  • My Account Integration – Adds a “Manage Returns” section to the WooCommerce customer area.
  • Admin Enhancements – Adds a returns status column and visual indicators to the Orders list.
  • HPOS Ready – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  • Invoice Plugin Compatibility – Compatible with invoice plugins such as WPO PDF Invoices & Packing Slips, ensuring refunds and exchanges are correctly reflected in generated documents.

External Services

This plugin acts as a connector between your WooCommerce store and the ReturnsUp platform (SaaS). An active ReturnsUp account is required for the plugin to function.

ReturnsUp Platform

  • Service Provider: ReturnsUp
  • Official website and subscription:
    https://returnsup.com
  • Management dashboard for registered stores:
    https://admin.returnsup.com
  • Returns and exchanges processing:
    https://app.returnsup.com
  • Data Transmission: Data is transmitted via secure API calls and Webhooks:
    • Connection Setup: Store URL and connection details are sent to verify your account.
    • Order Synchronization: Order identifiers, statuses, totals, and shipping details are synchronized to determine return eligibility.
    • Return Processing: Status updates and transaction totals are transmitted to process exchanges or refunds.
  • Terms of Service: https://returnsup.com/condiciones-del-servicio-de-returnsup/
  • Privacy Policy: https://returnsup.com/politica-de-privacidad/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/returnsup-connector directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → ReturnsUp to configure the connection.
  4. If you do not yet have a ReturnsUp account, you can find information and purchase a subscription at
    https://returnsup.com
  5. Once you have an account, access your management dashboard at
    https://admin.returnsup.com and obtain your API Key.
  6. Enter the API Key in the plugin settings, save changes, and you are ready to go.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ReturnsUp account?

Yes. This plugin requires an active ReturnsUp account. You can find information and purchase a subscription at https://returnsup.com.

What return options are available for customers?

Customers can choose between size exchanges, product exchanges, store credit refunds (with optional bonus incentives), or refunds to the original payment method, depending on your store’s configuration.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. ReturnsUp Connector is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Is it compatible with invoice plugins?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with invoice plugins such as WPO PDF Invoices & Packing Slips, ensuring refunds and exchanges are correctly reflected in invoices.

What languages are supported?

The portal currently supports English, Spanish, and French.
